decision: DO NOT RUN v3 (orchestrator rule: if the estimate exceeds 8 GPU-h, write it into the report and stop). With a hard fit budget inside 8 GPU-h the fit would very likely end budget-limited and non-converged, i.e. repeat the v2 failure mode instead of testing a converged fit. No v3 protocol was declared, no new dataset was generated, no truth was drawn.
